notes.title: 🛠 v0.2.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Update v0.2.2:
- 🛠 Fix: Resolved a rare crash issue to improve overall game stability.
Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: 🛠 v0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The v0.2.1 update introduces an important new feature:
✨ New Feature
Chinese language support: The game will now automatically switch to Simplified Chinese based on your system language, providing a better experience for Chinese-speaking players.

Thanks for playing and stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: 🛠 v0.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We’ve just released the v0.2.0 update with several improvements and new additions:

✨ New Features
Added sound effects for tapping, clearing, and other in-game actions to enhance player feedback and immersion.

⚙️ Improvements
Increased the speed of block-clearing animations for a smoother and more dynamic gameplay experience.

Thanks for all your feedback and support — more updates are on the way!
